title: Integral Homology and Poincaré Polynomials of classical and exceptional Real Flag Manifolds
summary: This paper computes the integral homology of real flag manifolds associated with split real forms of classical and exceptional semisimple Lie algebras. Using the cellular homology provided by the Bruhat decomposition, we introduce a unified framework to systematically determine the coefficients of the boundary operator, explicitly resolving the issue of calculating their signs. This is achieved by computing the degree of change of coordinate maps between different reduced decompositions of Weyl group elements, analyzing commutation and braid relations through Lie bracket computations and…
